subject: general
question: As part of Mission Mausam, India is building a cloud chamber at which institute?

options.text: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology, Pune

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology, Pune**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Mausam** is an initiative launched by the Government of India to reconnect and revive historical maritime cultural linkages between countries in the Indian Ocean Region (IOR).
 
• As part of **Mission Mausam**, a **cloud chamber** is being developed at the **Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM), Pune**, a leading research institute specializing in weather and climate studies.
 
• The cloud chamber is designed to study **cloud formation processes, atmospheric dynamics, and aerosol-cloud interactions**, which play a crucial role in climate and weather systems.
 
• IITM Pune is renowned for its research on **monsoon forecasting, climate modeling, and atmospheric phenomena**, making it an ideal location for this project.
 
• The initiative aligns with India's commitment to enhancing scientific research in meteorology and improving regional weather prediction capabilities.
 
• **Mission Mausam** also focuses on fostering cooperation among the nations in the Indian Ocean Region, emphasizing shared cultural and environmental heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM), Pune:**

 
 
• IITM Pune is an autonomous research institution under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India, established in **1962**.
 
• The institute conducts advanced research in **climate change, tropical meteorology, monsoon studies, and air quality monitoring.**
 
• It hosts the **Climate Research and Services Division**, which provides seasonal and sub-seasonal forecasts of monsoon and other weather phenomena.
 
• IITM is equipped with cutting-edge facilities like the **High-Performance Computing (HPC) system named Pratyush**, one of the fastest supercomputers in India.
 
• Key research contributions include improvements in **monsoon prediction models** and studies on the impact of **greenhouse gases and aerosols** on climate dynamics.
 
 
 
• **Mission Mausam:**
 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Culture in 2014, Mission Mausam aims to revive historical maritime routes and cultural ties among countries in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**.
 
• The project emphasizes **environmental sustainability** and the protection of maritime heritage.
 
• It promotes collaboration on **climate research, cultural exchanges, and regional cooperation**.
 
• Mission Mausam serves as a platform for addressing shared challenges like **climate change, disaster management, and biodiversity conservation.**
 
 
 
• **Cloud Chamber:**
 
 
• A cloud chamber is a scientific device used to visualize the paths of ionizing particles, aiding in the study of **cloud formation, precipitation processes, and atmospheric physics.**
 
• It simulates the conditions under which clouds form, providing insights into **aerosol-cloud interactions** and the role of various atmospheric components.
 
• Cloud chambers are crucial for enhancing **weather prediction accuracy** and understanding the impacts of human activities on **climate systems.**
 
 
 
• **Other Institutes Mentioned in the Options:**
 
 
• **Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru:** Established in **1909**, IISc is a premier research institution specializing in **advanced scientific and engineering research.**
 
• **Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi:** Known for its excellence in **engineering, technology, and applied sciences**, it was established in **1961**.
 
• **National Physical Laboratory, New Delhi:** Founded in **1947**, it focuses on **standardization, calibration, and precision measurements** in physical sciences.
 
• **Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology, Pune:** As explained above, it specializes in **climate and weather research** and is the correct answer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Importance of Cloud Chambers:**

 
 
• Cloud chambers play a vital role in the study of **aerosol-cloud interactions**, which influence climate and precipitation.
 
• They are used to simulate **atmospheric conditions**, helping scientists understand the **microphysics of clouds**.
 
• Insights gained from cloud chamber experiments contribute to improving **weather forecasting models**.
 
 
 
• **Global Collaboration:**
 
 
• Mission Mausam promotes international cooperation among IOR countries in addressing **climate-related challenges**.
 
• It strengthens ties in areas such as **scientific research, maritime heritage conservation, and disaster management.**
